payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates i in 0..162, forms p=s+i, checks if p-digit_sum(p)>=s. Counts those. After loop, if p<=n adds n-p since all larger numbers satisfy.
payload.rationale: Solution uses a mathematical bound s+162; conducts a small linear scan. No DP recurrence or state, no sorting, no complete search. dp_1d_state chosen as least inappropriate, but family mismatch.
